name: Lightbox
summary: A modal collection media viewer with keyboard and swipe navigation.

useWhen: Viewing a selected media item in a modal
Stepping through a collection of media items one at a time
avoidWhen: Modal content that is not a collection of media; use Dialog

obligations: Contain focus in the modal and restore it on close.

behavior: Closed content is not rendered, and renderContent is not called.
Each item needs a key that is a string or a finite number. label is optional.
If any item has an invalid key or repeats another item's key, the whole collection is empty.
A trigger whose itemKey is not in the collection is disabled.
Missing default selection resolves to the first valid item.
selectedKey and onSelectedChange control the selection. A selectedKey of null means nothing is selected.
A Lightbox with nothing selected shows nothing, and calls onOpenChange(false) once if it is open.
If the selected item leaves items and the selection is controlled, the Lightbox also calls onSelectedChange(null, null) once.
The owner applies these requests by setting selectedKey to null and open to false. The Lightbox repeats neither while selectedKey and open stay unchanged.
If the selected item leaves items and the selection is not controlled, the selection falls back to the first item and an open Lightbox closes.
renderContent on Lightbox receives the selected item and a context with key, index, and count.
renderContent on LightboxContent receives one object with item, key, index, and count, and takes precedence over the one on Lightbox.
Without either renderContent, LightboxContent renders its children.
In both render functions, item.label is the trimmed label, or the key as text when the label is missing or blank.
Arrow keys and swipes navigate the selected item in document direction.
Caption shows the selected item label unless it has children.
Caption is one line, and a long caption is cut off with an ellipsis.
Previous and Next are disabled at the first and last item unless loop is set.
accessibility: The popup is a focus-contained modal dialog.
The popup is named from the selected item's label, or its key when there is no label, unless aria-label or aria-labelledby is set on it.

requirements.reason: Native colors do not apply to web React.
Native font metrics do not apply to web React.
